_instructions: TWO-STAGE TEMPLATE (R13, R16-R20; HOLDOUT_RELEASE_RULING_v2.md). Only the Prophet programme CEO writes and commits the release files, and pushes them to origin/fable/rotation-core-20261110. The runner writes the run ledger itself (R20.1). Stage 1: copy 'stage1' to research/rotation_core/HOLDOUT_RELEASE_v2.json; inputs_sha256 and versions from `python scripts/run_rotation_core_v2.py --manifest stage1`. Stage 2: copy 'stage2' to research/rotation_core/HOLDOUT_RELEASE_v2_stage2.json; pin the ledger prefix that ends with the latest open GATE record (its length and chain hash, v2.chain_hash(entries[:n])); engine_commit equal to that run's. After any run without a record (START-only or INTEGRITY_ABORT), a release naming a new engine commit must cite those START indices in ledger_records_cited. A release version that was never used must be named in a later version's supersedes_unused_releases. The opening list is a constant in code (H1, H3). R22/R23: both releases pin branch_head_at_release (the remote head when the release is written; it must be an ancestor of the head at run time) and may name activity_anchor_commit (must be the header freeze commit). The stage-2 release also pins gate_commit (the commit the runner made for the GATE entry, printed as WITNESS gate_commit) and carries witnessed. versions carries sitecustomize_sha256, pth_count and pth_sha256. Run with `python -E -P -B -X pycache_prefix=/dev/shm/rotation_core_v2_pycache`. R25/R26: run with `python -E` (enforced); versions also carries tools and phase_a_ast_sha256 (from `python -E scripts/run_rotation_core_v2.py --manifest stage1`); the stage-2 witnessed block needs branch, release_commit, start_commit, gate_commit, witness_utc. After the release commit, do not run the test suite on the run host until that stage's record is on the remote. R27: run `--preflight` first (PASS required); stage 2 carries witness_confirmation_utc.

stage1.engine_commit: <final engine commit after the R15 rerun; stage-1 runs pin it (S7)>
stage1.branch_head_at_release: <40-hex remote head when this release is written>

stage2.engine_commit: <equal to the latest gate_history entry's engine_commit (S1a)>
stage2.ledger_prefix_len: <number of ledger entries through the latest open GATE record>
stage2.branch_head_at_release: <40-hex remote head when this release is written>
stage2.gate_commit: <40-hex commit holding the latest GATE entry (WITNESS gate_commit)>

witnessed.start_commit: <commit that recorded the stage-1 START (WITNESS start_commit)>

stage2.witness_confirmation_utc: <UTC of the witness's `match` answer; later than the GATE entry's utc>
